---
title: "Final Project, 2026 edition"
---

- For 2026, final project will be **individual** and will consist of the production of a pkgdown web site
using GitHub Pages 
- Specific deadlines
    - create your draft pkgdown web site by Nov 16 2026, instructions at the [template repo](https://vjcitn.github.io/bst260project-template/articles/instructions.html#infrastructure-accomplish-by-nov-16-2026)
        - forking the "template" repo, changing the name and settings, and running pkgdown to produce the
initial draft should take no more than 20 minutes
        - after successfully running pkgdown, you should be able to install your `finalproject` package with
`devtools::install_github("[yourGHusername]/finalproject")
    - create your proposal document and post in your web site by Nov 18 2026.  In this document you
will identify the datasets and scientific questions you wish to explore
        - this proposal document is stored as vignettes/proposal.qmd
    - your repo will be checked for success on Nov 17.
    - your proposal.qmd will be checked for success on Nov 19.
    - we will discuss further checkpoints on your project progress in classes after Thanksgiving
